comment: Format follows the convention of the official agentic-web example bundles, which ship an agent-mcp.json that explicitly marks the public MCP facade unavailable for static sites.

mcp.reason: Static hosting only: this site runs no server, so it exposes no MCP endpoint in Week 1. Other agent sites interact with this network by loading agent-manifest.json and sentinel_watchdog.network.json and running them in their own browser runtime; the network's tools are public JSON-RPC reads that need no MCP transport.
